Definition: Finding a pattern in random or selected data after the fact, then treating that pattern as if it was the target all along — like painting the target around bullet holes.
Example: A gambler notices he won on three Tuesdays and declares Tuesdays are his lucky winning pattern, ignoring all the Tuesdays he lost.
FaithDiscussionExample: Someone collects scattered numbers and dates from unrelated passages after an event and presents them as a precise prophecy of that event, having chosen only the fitting pieces afterward.
HowToRespond: Ask what was predicted beforehand: 'That is an interesting pattern — was it identified before the event, and does it hold up when we include the pieces that do not fit?'
